info.description: Loopback-only HTTP API of `gigai scout`. Writes need Content-Type: application/json and a Host of the bound 127.0.0.1/localhost port. Errors are {"error": {"code", "message"}}. x-gigai-effect says whether a route changes stored state; x-gigai-external says whether it spends a model call or reads the network.

get.description: One job, complete: posting, rank, assessment + requirement matrix, open questions, tailored resumes, job state, action links. Read only; never calls a model or the network. Aggregates the newest run posting, its rank, every run or quick assessment of the job (with the requirement matrix), the questions still unanswered, stored tailored resumes, the job's state with the events it accepts next, and the action links. The UI route `#/jobs/<posting url>` maps to this route. job_state may carry `assessment_stale: {reason: "posting_changed"}` (absent otherwise) when the assessment that gives the state was made on posting text that has since changed: the verdict still reads, and the job should be re-assessed.

parameters.description: The posting URL, raw or normalized (the UI's `#/jobs/<url>` route maps here).
